clue.text: Gain for female with sex appeal

clue.text: Park it in garden at first? That's telling

parts.note: the answer completes a compound with light that means thieving

clue.text: Moderate anger at end of voyage

parts.note: temper means anger, as in losing it

clue.text: Doctor seen with girls — that's sweet

definitions.note: used as a noun: a sweet substance

parts.note: MO is a medical officer, an army doctor
lasses are girls

clue.text: Plant from Himalayas medic's wasted

clue.text: Intro to aria with unusually strong melody

clue.text: Flower that's small found in street with no end of fruit

clue.text: Cheap comic one ordered

indicators.note: ordered here means put into a new order, so the letters of these words are rearranged

clue.text: Put weight on!

clue.text: And with this in France getting new rate — and the rest

clue.text: Methuselah's nerve?

clue.text: Alan being awkward losing answer that's making things possible

clue.text: Getting on with a good journalist

parts.note: ED is short for editor, a crossword journalist

clue.text: A measure to restrict strike if absolutely necessary

explanation.definitionFit: Examined means inspected closely, looked into in detail.

clue.text: Expert to pass diplomatic code

explanation.definitionFit: Protocol is the formal system of etiquette governing state and diplomatic occasions.

clue.text: Charlie on island — it's very hard

clue.text: French couturier having morning with a model?

clue.text: Cannon ball

clue.text: Fan not working, having had grease removed
